style: Rich storybook illustration in gouache and ink, inspired by Persian and Mughal miniature painting but original, warm saffron, terracotta, indigo and teal palette, soft golden-hour light, fine dark ink outlines, subtle paper texture. Match the painting style of the reference bazaar image exactly. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border.

rumor.prompt: Night in the same desert bazaar, seen from a quiet lantern-lit corner between two stalls. Two merchants lean together whispering. Far beyond the city gate, on the moonlit dunes, a long caravan of camels with glinting gold harnesses and black-and-gold wagons approaches.

arrival.prompt: The same bazaar street at golden dusk. A grand procession of ornate black-and-gold wagons with golden canopies and crimson pennants, pulled by camels in gold harness and led by porters in black-and-gold livery, rolls into the street toward the viewer. Townsfolk and stall keepers step aside and stare.

monopoly.prompt: The same bazaar street under a dark, bruised purple sky. Most stalls are shuttered with grey cloth. Long black-and-gold banners with a golden camel emblem hang over every awning. A thin queue of shoppers waits at a single gleaming black-and-gold wagon heaped with goods. Gloomy, oppressive mood.

seized.prompt: Close view of one striped merchant stall. Two porters in black-and-gold livery hang a black-and-gold banner with a golden camel emblem over the stall. The elderly stall owner in a green shawl watches, saddened. A torn parchment charter with a broken wax seal lies on the ground.

leaves.prompt: Dawn at the city gate of the desert town. The black-and-gold wagons with golden canopies roll out through the gate into the open desert, trailing dust. Behind them, merchants stand at their colorful stalls, cheering and waving.

wins.prompt: Night. The same bazaar street lies dark and silent, every stall shuttered and its lanterns out. Only the black-and-gold wagons glow, hung with golden lanterns, and a huge black-and-gold banner with a golden camel emblem hangs across the road to the palace. Lonely, defeated mood.

end.prompt: Late evening in the same bazaar after the market closes. Merchants pack goods into chests and lower their awnings, a few lanterns still glow warmly, stars come out above the domed palace. Peaceful, content mood.

festival.prompt: Festival of Lanterns at night in the same bazaar. Hundreds of glowing paper sky lanterns rise over the striped awnings and the domed palace, crowds of townsfolk in festive clothes look up and point, strings of lanterns everywhere.

storm.prompt: A sudden storm lashes the same bazaar. Heavy slanting rain, dark grey-blue clouds, awnings straining in the wind, merchants hurrying to pull covers over spice pyramids and silk, puddles on the road, a flash of lightning over the palace.

caravan.prompt: A great silk caravan enters the same bazaar street: a line of camels laden with rolled bolts of colorful silk, led by camel drivers in saffron robes, walking up the road between the stalls toward the viewer; merchants rush out to look.

crier.prompt: Bust portrait in exactly the same style and framing as the reference portraits: a proud, booming town crier in a crimson coat with gold braid and a tall feathered turban, holding a brass hand bell, mouth open mid-announcement, centered on a plain warm parchment-toned background with a faint arch shape behind the head, game character card art.
